---
title: "Quarto Dashboard"
format: dashboard
orientation: columns
theme: yeti

---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

#Read in adsl
adsl <- read_sas("//wilbtia/wilbtia10/PPD SandboxWIL/R Academy/Databases/Analysis Database/Output/adsl.sas7bdat")

```


## Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: Data

adsl2 <- adsl %>% 
         select(USUBJID, TRT01P, TRTDURD, WEIGHTBL, HEIGHTBL)

adslm <- adsl2 %>% 
         mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

datatable(adslm,
          extensions = c('ColReorder'), 
          rownames = FALSE, filter = 'top',
          options = list(colReorder = TRUE, lengthMenu = c(18,50,100),
                         scrollX = FALSE))

```

## Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| title: Figure 1

f1 <- ggplot(data = adsl, aes(x=TRT01P,y=TRTDURD,fill=TRT01P)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_discrete(name="Treatment Group") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,250), breaks=seq(0,250,50), expand=c(0.05,0.05), name="Treatment Duration") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7"), name="Treatment Group") +
  theme_bw()

ggplotly(f1)


```

```{r}
#| title: Figure 2

f2 <- ggplot(data = adsl, aes(x=WEIGHTBL,y=HEIGHTBL,shape=TRT01P)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(30,110), breaks=seq(30,110,10), name="Baseline Height") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(130,200), breaks=seq(130,200,10), name="Baseline Weight") +
  theme_bw()

ggplotly(f2)


```
